<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Anubis OSS — Local LLM Benchmarking for Apple Silicon</title>
    <style>
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        body {
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
            color: #e0e0e0;
            background: #0a0a0a;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(108,180,238,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(108,180,238,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        a { color: #6cb4ee; text-decoration: none; }
        a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

        .container { max-width: 980px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }

        /* ── Hero ── */
        .hero { text-align: center; padding: 80px 0 48px; position: relative; }

        .hero::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 40px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 400px;
            height: 400px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(108,180,238,0.08) 0%, transparent 70%);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .hero > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        .hero-icon {
            width: 80px;
            height: 92px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(108,180,238,0.3));
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-size: 44px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            color: #fff;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .hero h1 .accent {
            color: #6cb4ee;
            text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(108,180,238,0.3);
        }

        .hero .version {
            display: inline-block;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: rgba(108,180,238,0.1);
            color: #6cb4ee;
            border: 1px solid rgba(108,180,238,0.2);
            margin-left: 8px;
            vertical-align: super;
        }

        .hero .tagline {
            font-size: 18px;
            color: #888;
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto 12px;
        }

        .hero .sub-tagline {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: #555;
            margin-bottom: 28px;
        }

        .badges {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }

        .badge {
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            background: rgba(108,180,238,0.06);
            color: #7a8599;
            border: 1px solid rgba(108,180,238,0.1);
            letter-spacing: 0.03em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .buttons {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .btn {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 11px 22px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: all 0.2s;
            border: 1px solid transparent;
        }

        .btn:hover { text-decoration: none; }

        .btn-primary {
            background: #fff;
            color: #000;
            font-weight: 600;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
        }

        .btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

        .btn-secondary {
            background: #111318;
            color: #ccc;
            border-color: #1c2333;
        }

        .btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #6cb4ee; color: #6cb4ee; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(108,180,238,0.1); }

        .btn-glow {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(108,180,238,0.15) 0%, rgba(108,180,238,0.05) 100%);
            color: #6cb4ee;
            border-color: rgba(108,180,238,0.25);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .btn-glow:hover { border-color: #6cb4ee; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(108,180,238,0.2); }

        /* ── Stats row ── */
        .stats-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 40px;
            padding: 32px 0;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .stat {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .stat-value {
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #fff;
            font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
            text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(108,180,238,0.2);
        }

        .stat-value .unit {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: #6cb4ee;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #555;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }

        /* ── Screenshots ── */
        .screenshots { padding: 32px 0 48px; }

        .screenshot-frame {
            position: relative;
            border-radius: 12px;
            border: 1px solid #1c2333;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            background: #0d0d12;
            box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(108,180,238,0.04), 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
        }

        .screenshot-frame img {
            width: 100%;
            display: block;
        }

        .screenshot-placeholder {
            width: 100%;
            aspect-ratio: 16/9;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0e1018 0%, #0a0a10 100%);
            color: #3a4a60;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .screenshot-placeholder .ph-icon {
            font-size: 32px;
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        .screenshot-label {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 12px;
            left: 16px;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            color: #5a6a80;
            background: rgba(10,10,14,0.85);
            padding: 4px 10px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
        }

        /* ── Section shared ── */
        .section { padding: 56px 0; }
        .section-border { border-top: 1px solid rgba(108,180,238,0.06); }

        .section h2 {
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #fff;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            text-align: center;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        .section h2 .accent {
            color: #6cb4ee;
            text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(108,180,238,0.2);
        }

        .section .section-sub {
            font-size: 15px;
            color: #666;
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto 36px;
        }

        /* ── Why section ── */
        .why-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .why-item {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #101318 0%, #0d0d12 100%);
            border: 1px solid #1c2333;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 20px;
            transition: border-color 0.2s;
        }

        .why-item:hover { border-color: rgba(108,180,238,0.2); }

        .why-item.highlight {
            border-color: rgba(108,180,238,0.25);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0e1220 0%, #0c0e18 100%);
        }

        .why-item .label {
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #5a6a80;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .why-item.highlight .label { color: #6cb4ee; }

        .why-item .text { font-size: 14px; color: #999; line-height: 1.5; }
        .why-item.highlight .text { color: #bbb; }

        /* ── Features grid ── */
        .feature-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 16px;
        }

        .feature-card {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #101318 0%, #0d0d0d 100%);
            border: 1px solid #1c2333;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 24px;
            transition: border-color 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s, transform 0.2s;
        }

        .feature-card:hover {
            border-color: rgba(108,180,238,0.2);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(108,180,238,0.05);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .feature-icon {
            font-size: 22px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            display: inline-block;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            line-height: 40px;
            text-align: center;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: rgba(108,180,238,0.06);
            border: 1px solid rgba(108,180,238,0.1);
        }

        .feature-card h3 {
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #e5e5e5;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .feature-card p {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: #777;
            line-height: 1.55;
        }

        /* ── Backends ── */
        .backend-list {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .backend-chip {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 500;
            padding: 8px 18px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #111318 0%, #0e0e14 100%);
            border: 1px solid #1c2333;
            color: #99aadd;
            transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
        }

        .backend-chip:hover {
            border-color: rgba(108,180,238,0.3);
            color: #6cb4ee;
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(108,180,238,0.1);
        }

        /* ── Metrics table ── */
        .metrics-wrap {
            border-radius: 12px;
            border: 1px solid #1c2333;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #101318 0%, #0d0d0d 100%);
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(108,180,238,0.03);
        }

        .metrics-wrap table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }

        .metrics-wrap th {
            text-align: left;
            color: #5a6a80;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 11px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #161a22 0%, #12151b 100%);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(108,180,238,0.1);
        }

        .metrics-wrap td {
            padding: 10px 16px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #1a1a1a;
            color: #999;
        }

        .metrics-wrap td:first-child { color: #e0e0e0; font-weight: 500; }

        .metrics-wrap tbody tr { transition: background 0.15s; }
        .metrics-wrap tbody tr:hover { background: #141820; }
        .metrics-wrap tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

        code {
            font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            background: rgba(108,180,238,0.06);
            padding: 2px 7px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            color: #99aadd;
            border: 1px solid rgba(108,180,238,0.08);
        }

        /* ── Requirements ── */
        .req-grid {
            display: flex;
            gap: 14px;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .req-item {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #101318 0%, #0d0d12 100%);
            border: 1px solid #1c2333;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 22px 30px;
            text-align: center;
            transition: border-color 0.2s;
            min-width: 160px;
        }

        .req-item:hover { border-color: rgba(108,180,238,0.2); }

        .req-item .val {
            font-size: 17px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #fff;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .req-item .desc {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #555;
        }

        /* ── Leaderboard teaser ── */
        .leaderboard-teaser {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 24px;
            padding: 24px 28px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0e1220 0%, #0c0e18 100%);
            border: 1px solid rgba(108,180,238,0.15);
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            transition: border-color 0.3s, transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.3s;
            margin-top: 8px;
        }

        .leaderboard-teaser:hover {
            border-color: rgba(108,180,238,0.35);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            text-decoration: none;
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(108,180,238,0.08);
        }

        .leaderboard-teaser-icon {
            font-size: 36px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            line-height: 56px;
            text-align: center;
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: rgba(108,180,238,0.08);
            border: 1px solid rgba(108,180,238,0.12);
        }

        .leaderboard-teaser-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

        .leaderboard-teaser-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: rgba(108,180,238,0.1);
            color: #6cb4ee;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .leaderboard-teaser-title {
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #e5e5e5;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
        }

        .leaderboard-teaser-sub {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: #666;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .leaderboard-teaser-arrow {
            font-size: 20px;
            color: #333;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            transition: color 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
        }

        .leaderboard-teaser:hover .leaderboard-teaser-arrow {
            color: #6cb4ee;
            transform: translateX(3px);
        }

        /* ── CTA ── */
        .cta {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 64px 0 56px;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(108,180,238,0.06);
        }

        .cta h2 {
            font-size: 26px;
            color: #fff;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        .cta p {
            color: #666;
            margin-bottom: 28px;
            font-size: 15px;
        }

        /* ── Bundle card ── */
        .bundle-card {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
            padding: 20px 24px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #101318 0%, #0d0d0d 100%);
            border: 1px solid #1c2333;
            transition: border-color 0.3s, transform 0.2s;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            margin-top: 32px;
        }

        .bundle-card:hover {
            border-color: #333;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .bundle-card-icon {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .bundle-card-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

        .bundle-card-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: rgba(136,136,204,0.1);
            color: #8888cc;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .bundle-card-title {
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #e5e5e5;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .bundle-card-sub { font-size: 13px; color: #666; }

        .bundle-card-arrow {
            font-size: 18px;
            color: #333;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            transition: color 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
        }

        .bundle-card:hover .bundle-card-arrow {
            color: #6cb4ee;
            transform: translateX(3px);
        }

        /* ── OSS note ── */
        .oss-note {
            padding: 16px 20px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #101318 0%, #0d0d12 100%);
            border: 1px solid #1c2333;
            margin-top: 32px;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #888;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .oss-note strong { color: #ccc; }

        /* ── Support row ── */
        .support-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            justify-content: center;
            margin-top: 24px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .support-btn {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            background: #111318;
            border: 1px solid #1c2333;
            color: #aaa;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 500;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s;
        }

        .support-btn:hover {
            border-color: #444;
            color: #e5e5e5;
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .support-btn svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: currentColor; }

        /* ── Footer ── */
        footer {
            padding: 32px 24px;
            text-align: center;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(108,180,238,0.06);
            font-size: 13px;
            color: #444;
        }

        footer a { color: #555; }
        footer a:hover { color: #6cb4ee; }

        .footer-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: 8px;
        }

        /* ── Promo banner ── */
        .promo-banner {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 12px;
            padding: 12px 24px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(108,180,238,0.1) 0%, rgba(108,180,238,0.03) 100%);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(108,180,238,0.15);
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            transition: background 0.2s;
        }
        .promo-banner:hover {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(108,180,238,0.15) 0%, rgba(108,180,238,0.06) 100%);
            text-decoration: none;
        }
        .promo-banner-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            padding: 3px 10px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: rgba(108,180,238,0.15);
            color: #6cb4ee;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .promo-banner-text {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #ccc;
        }
        .promo-banner-text strong { color: #fff; }
        .promo-banner-arrow {
            color: #6cb4ee;
            font-size: 16px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }
        .promo-banner:hover .promo-banner-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

        /* ── Responsive ── */
        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .hero h1 { font-size: 30px; }
            .hero .tagline { font-size: 16px; }
            .feature-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .why-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .stats-row { gap: 24px; }
            .stat-value { font-size: 22px; }
            .leaderboard-teaser { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
            .bundle-card { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <a class="promo-banner" href="https://uncsoft.github.io/anubis-oss/analysis.html">
        <span class="promo-banner-badge">New</span>
        <span class="promo-banner-text"><strong>Benchmark Analysis Report</strong> — Deep dive into 375+ community runs across 10+ Apple Silicon chips with interactive charts</span>
        <span class="promo-banner-arrow">→</span>
    </a>

    <div class="container">

        <!-- ── Hero ── -->
        <section class="hero">
            <img src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4369ce8d-8f3a-4502-9c49-6f3a82372e00" alt="Anubis icon" class="hero-icon">
            <h1><span class="accent">Anubis</span> OSS <span class="version">v2</span></h1>
            <p class="tagline">Real-time LLM benchmarking and hardware telemetry for Apple Silicon</p>
            <p class="sub-tagline">The only native macOS tool that correlates inference performance with GPU, CPU, power, and memory metrics in real time.</p>

            <div class="badges">
                <span class="badge">macOS 15+</span>
                <span class="badge">Apple Silicon</span>
                <span class="badge">SwiftUI</span>
                <span class="badge">GPL-3.0</span>
                <span class="badge">Open Source</span>
            </div>

            <div class="buttons">
                <a href="https://github.com/uncSoft/anubis-oss/releases/latest" class="btn btn-primary">Download Latest</a>
                <a href="https://github.com/uncSoft/anubis-oss" class="btn btn-secondary">GitHub</a>
                <a href="https://devpadapp.com/leaderboard.html" class="btn btn-glow">Leaderboard</a>
                <a href="https://devpadapp.com/anubis-oss-readme.html" class="btn btn-secondary">Docs</a>
                <a href="https://ko-fi.com/jtatuncsoft/tip" class="btn btn-secondary">Support</a>
            </div>
        </section>

        <!-- ── Stats ── -->
        <div class="stats-row">
            <div class="stat">
                <div class="stat-value">100+<span class="unit">+</span></div>
                <div class="stat-label">GitHub Stars</div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat">
                <div class="stat-value">150+<span class="unit">+</span></div>
                <div class="stat-label">Benchmark Submissions</div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat">
                <div class="stat-value">8<span class="unit">+</span></div>
                <div class="stat-label">Backends Supported</div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat">
                <div class="stat-value">9<span class="unit"></span></div>
                <div class="stat-label">Hardware Metrics</div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
       <div class="stats-row">
        <div class="footer-links">
            <a href="https://devpadapp.com">devPad</a>
            <a href="https://cyberWriter.app">cyberWriter</a>
            <a href="https://apps.apple.com/us/app-bundle/the-architects-toolkit/id1874965091?mt=12">App Store Bundle</a>
            <a href="https://ko-fi.com/jtatuncsoft/tip">Ko-fi</a>
            <a href="https://devpadapp.com/anubis/privacy.html">Privacy</a>
            </div>
        </div>

        <section class="screenshots">

        <!-- ── Why Anubis ── -->
        <section class="section section-border">
            <h2>Why <span class="accent">Anubis</span>?</h2>
            <p class="section-sub">The local LLM ecosystem on macOS is fragmented. Chat wrappers focus on conversation, monitors are CLI-only, and nothing correlates hardware with inference.</p>
            <div class="why-grid">
                <div class="why-item">
                    <div class="label">Chat Wrappers</div>
                    <div class="text">Ollama, LM Studio, Jan focus on conversation -; not systematic performance testing or hardware analysis.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="why-item">
                    <div class="label">CLI Monitors</div>
                    <div class="text">asitop, macmon, mactop show hardware stats but have no LLM context or inference correlation.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="why-item">
                    <div class="label">Eval Frameworks</div>
                    <div class="text">promptfoo and similar tools require YAML configs and terminal expertise. No native GUI, no telemetry.</div>
                </div>
                <div class="why-item highlight">
                    <div class="label">Anubis</div>
                    <div class="text">Native macOS app that correlates GPU, CPU, power, memory, and frequency with live inference -; with one-click benchmarks and community leaderboards.</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>

        <!-- ── Features ── -->
        <section class="section section-border">
            <h2>Features</h2>
            <p class="section-sub">Everything you need to benchmark, compare, and understand local LLM performance on your Mac.</p>
            <div class="feature-grid">
                <div class="feature-card">
                    <div class="feature-icon">◇</div>
                    <h3>Benchmark Dashboard</h3>
                    <p>Real-time dashboard with 8+ metric cards, 30 data points, 11 live charts, power telemetry, and configurable prompt presets. Exportable and comparable results and reports. Stream responses with live hardware overlay.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="feature-card">
                    <div class="feature-icon">⚖</div>
                    <h3>Arena Mode</h3>
                    <p>Side-by-side A/B model comparison with sequential or parallel execution. Vote for a winner -; results are persisted with full stats.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="feature-card">
                    <div class="feature-icon">□</div>
                    <h3>Vault</h3>
                    <p>Unified model management across all backends. Pull, delete, inspect, and unload models. Auto-enriched metadata from HuggingFace.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="feature-card">
                    <div class="feature-icon">⚡</div>
                    <h3>Power Telemetry</h3>
                    <p>GPU, CPU, ANE, and DRAM power in watts via IOReport. See watts-per-token efficiency and compare quantizations by actual power cost.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="feature-card">
                    <div class="feature-icon">⚙</div>
                    <h3>Process Monitoring</h3>
                    <p>Auto-detects backend process by port. Tracks real memory footprint including Metal/GPU allocations. Manual override available.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="feature-card">
                    <div class="feature-icon">↗</div>
                    <h3>Export & History</h3>
                    <p>Full session history with replay. Export as CSV, Markdown, or shareable 2x retina PNG. Respects light and dark mode.</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>
